description.en:
Basic Attack - Drink Soul

While in the Yin Vessel state, perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG.
Casting Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 3 restores 50 points of Qi, dealing Heavy Attack DMG.
Casting Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 4 restores 50 points of Qi, dealing Heavy Attack DMG.

Basic Attack - Devil's Bane

While in the Yang Font state, perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG.
Casting Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 3 restores 50 points of Qi, dealing Heavy Attack DMG.
Casting Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 4 restores 50 points of Qi, dealing Heavy Attack DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack in the air, dealing Fusion DMG.
While in the Yin Vessel state, press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.
While in the Yang Font state, press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Nether Dive

While in the Yin Vessel state, press or hold Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.
Casting Dodge Counter - Nether Dive restores 100 points of Qi, dealing Heavy Attack DMG.
Press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 4.

Dodge Counter - Light Watch

While in the Yang Font state, press or hold Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.
Casting Dodge Counter - Light Watch restores 100 points of Qi, dealing Heavy Attack DMG.
Press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 4.

Shadow Step

While in combat and on the ground, press Dodge with directional input to cast Shadow Step, dealing a fixed amount of Fusion DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG. This instance of damage is not affected by any DMG Bonus effects. A successful Dodge may be triggered within a certain time during the action of this skill.
While in the Yin Vessel state, press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.
While in the Yang Font state, press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.
description.id:
Basic Attack - Drink Soul

Saat dalam kondisi Yin Vessel, melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Fusion DMG.
Menggunakan Basic Attack - Drink Soul Tahap 3 memulihkan 50 poin Qi, memberikan Heavy Attack DMG.
Menggunakan Basic Attack - Drink Soul Tahap 4 memulihkan 50 poin Qi, memberikan Heavy Attack DMG.

Basic Attack - Devil's Bane

Saat dalam kondisi Yang Font, melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Fusion DMG.
Menggunakan Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Tahap 3 memulihkan 50 poin Qi, memberikan Heavy Attack DMG.
Menggunakan Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Tahap 4 memulihkan 50 poin Qi, memberikan Heavy Attack DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack di udara, memberikan Fusion DMG.
Saat dalam kondisi Yin Vessel, tekan atau tahan Normal Attack sesaat setelah menggunakan skill ini untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Drink Soul Tahap 2.
Saat dalam kondisi Yang Font, tekan atau tahan Normal Attack sesaat setelah menggunakan skill ini untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Tahap 2.

Dodge Counter - Nether Dive

Saat dalam kondisi Yin Vessel, tekan atau tahan Normal Attack sesaat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG.
Menggunakan Dodge Counter - Nether Dive memulihkan 100 poin Qi, memberikan Heavy Attack DMG.
Tekan atau tahan Normal Attack sesaat setelah menggunakan skill ini untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Drink Soul Tahap 4.

Dodge Counter - Light Watch

Saat dalam kondisi Yang Font, tekan atau tahan Normal Attack sesaat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG.
Menggunakan Dodge Counter - Light Watch memulihkan 100 poin Qi, memberikan Heavy Attack DMG.
Tekan atau tahan Normal Attack sesaat setelah menggunakan skill ini untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Tahap 4.

Shadow Step

Saat dalam pertempuran dan berada di darat, tekan Dodge dengan input arah untuk menggunakan Shadow Step, memberikan Fusion DMG dalam jumlah tetap, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG. Damage ini tidak dipengaruhi efek DMG Bonus apa pun. Dodge yang berhasil dapat terpicu dalam waktu tertentu selama gerakan skill ini.
Saat dalam kondisi Yin Vessel, tekan atau tahan Normal Attack sesaat setelah menggunakan skill ini untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Drink Soul Tahap 2.
Saat dalam kondisi Yang Font, tekan atau tahan Normal Attack sesaat setelah menggunakan skill ini untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Tahap 2.

description.en:
Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin

While in the Yin Vessel state, Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin is available, which deals Fusion DMG.
Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin can be cast in mid-air.

Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang

While in the Yang Font state, Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang is available, which deals Fusion DMG.
Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang can be cast in mid-air.

Cleanse of Impurity

Casting Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin or Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang grants Cleanse of Impurity for 4s or until one of the following conditions is met:
- Switching to another Resonator.
- Switching to the Yin Vessel or Yang Font state.
- Casting Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse or Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide.

Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse

While in the Yin Vessel state with Cleanse of Impurity, press or hold Normal Attack in mid-air to cast Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Casting Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse restores 100 points of Qi.
Press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.

Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide

While in the Yang Font state with Cleanse of Impurity, press or hold Normal Attack in mid-air to cast Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Casting Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide restores 100 points of Qi.
Press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.
description.id:
Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin

Saat dalam kondisi Yin Vessel, Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin tersedia, yang memberikan Fusion DMG.
Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin dapat dilakukan di udara.

Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang

Saat dalam kondisi Yang Font, Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang tersedia, yang memberikan Fusion DMG.
Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang dapat dilakukan di udara.

Cleanse of Impurity

Menggunakan Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin atau Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang memberikan Cleanse of Impurity selama 4 dtk atau hingga salah satu kondisi berikut terpenuhi:
- Berganti ke Resonator lain.
- Berganti ke kondisi Yin Vessel atau Yang Font.
- Menggunakan Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse atau Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide.

Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse

Saat dalam kondisi Yin Vessel dengan Cleanse of Impurity, tekan atau tahan Normal Attack di udara untuk menggunakan Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, memberikan Fusion DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.
Menggunakan Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse memulihkan 100 poin Qi.
Tekan atau tahan Normal Attack sesaat setelah menggunakan skill ini untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Drink Soul Tahap 2.

Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide

Saat dalam kondisi Yang Font dengan Cleanse of Impurity, tekan atau tahan Normal Attack di udara untuk menggunakan Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide, memberikan Fusion DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.
Menggunakan Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide memulihkan 100 poin Qi.
Tekan atau tahan Normal Attack sesaat setelah menggunakan skill ini untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Tahap 2.

description.en:
Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG, and granting 100 points of Fire of Life.
Gain the following effects after casting this skill:
- If Jingran's current HP is above 50% of the Max HP, reduce his current HP to 50% of the Max HP.
- Gain 200 points of Qi.
- Gain 3 stacks of Wayfarer's Mark.
- Enter the Yinghuo state for 15s.

Wayfarer's Mark

Max 3 stacks.
Casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander restores 200 points of Qi and reduces 1 stacks of Wayfarer's Mark. This effect lasts for 15s.

Yinghuo

- Dealing damage with Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander summons Chimei Wangliang to attack the targets, which deals Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG. This effect can be triggered once per Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander.
- All Fire of Life will be removed as Yinghuo ends.
description.id:
Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls dapat dilakukan di udara saat dekat dengan tanah.
Menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG, dan memberikan 100 poin Fire of Life.
Mendapat efek berikut setelah menggunakan skill ini:
- Jika HP Jingran saat ini di atas 50% dari Max HP, kurangi HP-nya menjadi 50% dari Max HP.
- Mendapat 200 poin Qi.
- Mendapat 3 stack Wayfarer's Mark.
- Memasuki kondisi Yinghuo selama 15 dtk.

Wayfarer's Mark

Maksimal 3 stack.
Menggunakan Heavy Attack - Soul Raid atau Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander memulihkan 200 poin Qi dan mengurangi 1 stack Wayfarer's Mark. Efek ini berlangsung selama 15 dtk.

Yinghuo

- Memberikan damage dengan Heavy Attack - Soul Raid atau Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander memanggil Chimei Wangliang untuk menyerang target, yang memberikan Fusion DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali untuk setiap Heavy Attack - Soul Raid atau Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander.
- Seluruh Fire of Life akan dihapus saat Yinghuo berakhir.

description.en:
Casting Intro Skill - Question the Tombs, Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin, or Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang grants Earth Charm.

Earth Charm

For 15s, if Jingran is the active Resonator in the team, gain an unstackable Shield equal to 1.6% of Max HP + 700 that lasts for 5s when dealing damage. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.
While Jingran is in the Yinghuo state, if he is the active Resonator in the team, he gains an unstackable Shield equal to 0.8% of Max HP + 350 that lasts for 5s when dealing damage. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.
description.id:
Menggunakan Intro Skill - Question the Tombs, Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin, atau Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang memberikan Earth Charm.

Earth Charm

Selama 15 dtk, jika Jingran adalah Resonator aktif dalam tim, mendapat Shield yang tidak dapat ditumpuk sebesar 1,6% Max HP + 700 yang bertahan selama 5 dtk saat memberikan damage. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 0,5 dtk. Shield ini tidak akan diteruskan ke Resonator yang masuk.
Saat Jingran dalam kondisi Yinghuo, jika ia adalah Resonator aktif dalam tim, ia mendapat Shield yang tidak dapat ditumpuk sebesar 0,8% Max HP + 350 yang bertahan selama 5 dtk saat memberikan damage. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 0,5 dtk. Shield ini tidak akan diteruskan ke Resonator yang masuk.

description.en:
Upon entering combat, if Jingran's Ghost Shroud is below 25 points, restore it to 25 points. This effect can be triggered once every 4s.

When nearby Resonators in the team other than Jingran gain a Shield, Jingran gains 2 points of Ghost Shroud. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.

Fixation

- Upon entering combat, Jingran gains Fixation. This effect can be triggered once every 4s.
- Casting Outro Skill - Rising Fortune and Ebbing Evil grants Fixation.
- When nearby Resonators in the team other than Jingran gain a Shield, Jingran gains 15 points of Ghost Shroud and removes Fixation.
description.id:
Saat memasuki pertempuran, jika Ghost Shroud Jingran di bawah 25 poin, pulihkan menjadi 25 poin. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 4 dtk.

Saat Resonator di sekitar dalam tim selain Jingran mendapat Shield, Jingran mendapat 2 poin Ghost Shroud. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 0,5 dtk.

Fixation

- Saat memasuki pertempuran, Jingran mendapat Fixation. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 4 dtk.
- Menggunakan Outro Skill - Rising Fortune and Ebbing Evil memberikan Fixation.
- Saat Resonator di sekitar dalam tim selain Jingran mendapat Shield, Jingran mendapat 15 poin Ghost Shroud dan Fixation dihapus.

description.en:
Attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG. Consume and convert all Ghost Shroud to equal stacks of Fortune in Disguise.
Casting Question the Tombs restores 100 points of Qi.
While in the Yin Vessel state, press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.
While in the Yang Font state, press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.

Fortune in Disguise

Max 50 stacks. Each stack of Fortune in Disguise grants additional Fusion DMG Bonus based on Jingran's Max HP: For every 1000 points of Max HP, Jingran gains 0.05% additional Fusion DMG Bonus for 15s, up to 2.5% for each stack of Fortune in Disguise.
Switching to another Resonator ends the effect.

Ghost Shroud

- Max 50 points.
- When Jingran gains a Shield, he gains 1 points of Ghost Shroud. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.
description.id:
Menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG. Mengonsumsi dan mengubah seluruh Ghost Shroud menjadi stack Fortune in Disguise dalam jumlah yang sama.
Menggunakan Question the Tombs memulihkan 100 poin Qi.
Saat dalam kondisi Yin Vessel, tekan atau tahan Normal Attack sesaat setelah menggunakan skill ini untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Drink Soul Tahap 2.
Saat dalam kondisi Yang Font, tekan atau tahan Normal Attack sesaat setelah menggunakan skill ini untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Tahap 2.

Fortune in Disguise

Maksimal 50 stack. Setiap stack Fortune in Disguise memberikan tambahan Fusion DMG Bonus berdasarkan Max HP Jingran: untuk setiap 1000 poin Max HP, Jingran mendapat tambahan 0,05% Fusion DMG Bonus selama 15 dtk, hingga 2,5% untuk setiap stack Fortune in Disguise.
Berganti ke Resonator lain mengakhiri efek ini.

Ghost Shroud

- Maksimal 50 poin.
- Saat Jingran mendapat Shield, ia mendapat 1 poin Ghost Shroud. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 0,5 dtk.

description.en:
Qi Modulation

Jingran switches between the Yin Vessel and Yang Font states by casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander. Jingran is in the Yang Font state by default.

Heavy Attack - Soul Raid

When Jingran holds 300 points of Qi while in the Yin Vessel state, hold Normal Attack to consume 300 points of Qi to cast Heavy Attack - Soul Raid, dealing Fusion DMG.
After casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid, Jingran switches to the Yang Font state.
Press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.

Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander

When Jingran holds 300 points of Qi while in the Yang Font state, hold Normal Attack to consume 300 points of Qi to cast Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander, dealing Fusion DMG.
After casting Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander, Jingran switches to the Yin Vessel state.
Press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.
Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander can be cast in mid-air.

Qi

Max 300 points.
- Casting Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 3, Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 4, Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 3, or Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 4 restores 50 points of Qi.
- Casting Dodge Counter - Nether Dive, Dodge Counter - Light Watch, Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide, or Intro Skill - Question the Tombs restores 100 points of Qi.
- Casting Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls or casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander with Wayfarer's Mark restores 200 points of Qi.

Fire of Life

Max 100 points.
- Casting Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls grants 100 points of Fire of Life.
- All Fire of Life is cleared when Yinghuo ends.
While in Yinghuo, if Fire of Life is not at 0 points, casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander consumes 25 points of Fire of Life, and the DMG Multiplier of this Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander is increased based on Jingran's Max HP: The DMG Multiplier of this Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander is increased for every 1000 points of Jingran's Max HP over 25000. Up to 25000 points of Jingran's Max HP count towards this effect.

Nether to Light

- Jingran's DEF is fixed at 0.
- Jingran gains Incoming Healing Bonus based on Max HP: For every 1000 points of Max HP, Jingran receives 6.2% Incoming Healing Bonus, up to 310%.
- Jingran gains Fusion DMG Bonus based on Max HP: For every 1000 points of Max HP, Jingran receives 1.5% Fusion DMG Bonus, up to 75%.

Yang Changes, Yin Unites

Jingran gains additional ATK based on Max HP: For every 1000 points of Max HP, Jingran gains 36 additional ATK, up to 1800.
description.id:
Qi Modulation

Jingran berganti antara kondisi Yin Vessel dan Yang Font dengan menggunakan Heavy Attack - Soul Raid atau Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander. Jingran berada dalam kondisi Yang Font secara default.

Heavy Attack - Soul Raid

Saat Jingran memiliki 300 poin Qi dalam kondisi Yin Vessel, tahan Normal Attack untuk mengonsumsi 300 poin Qi guna menggunakan Heavy Attack - Soul Raid, memberikan Fusion DMG.
Setelah menggunakan Heavy Attack - Soul Raid, Jingran berganti ke kondisi Yang Font.
Tekan atau tahan Normal Attack sesaat setelah menggunakan skill ini untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Tahap 2.

Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander

Saat Jingran memiliki 300 poin Qi dalam kondisi Yang Font, tahan Normal Attack untuk mengonsumsi 300 poin Qi guna menggunakan Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander, memberikan Fusion DMG.
Setelah menggunakan Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander, Jingran berganti ke kondisi Yin Vessel.
Tekan atau tahan Normal Attack sesaat setelah menggunakan skill ini untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Drink Soul Tahap 2.
Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander dapat dilakukan di udara.

Qi

Maksimal 300 poin.
- Menggunakan Basic Attack - Drink Soul Tahap 3, Basic Attack - Drink Soul Tahap 4, Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Tahap 3, atau Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Tahap 4 memulihkan 50 poin Qi.
- Menggunakan Dodge Counter - Nether Dive, Dodge Counter - Light Watch, Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide, atau Intro Skill - Question the Tombs memulihkan 100 poin Qi.
- Menggunakan Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls atau menggunakan Heavy Attack - Soul Raid atau Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander dengan Wayfarer's Mark memulihkan 200 poin Qi.

Fire of Life

Maksimal 100 poin.
- Menggunakan Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls memberikan 100 poin Fire of Life.
- Seluruh Fire of Life dihapus saat Yinghuo berakhir.
Saat dalam Yinghuo, jika Fire of Life tidak berada di 0 poin, menggunakan Heavy Attack - Soul Raid atau Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander mengonsumsi 25 poin Fire of Life, dan Pengali DMG Heavy Attack - Soul Raid atau Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander ini meningkat berdasarkan Max HP Jingran: Pengali DMG Heavy Attack - Soul Raid atau Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander ini meningkat untuk setiap 1000 poin Max HP Jingran di atas 25000. Hingga 25000 poin Max HP Jingran dihitung untuk efek ini.

Nether to Light

- DEF Jingran tetap di 0.
- Jingran mendapat Incoming Healing Bonus berdasarkan Max HP: untuk setiap 1000 poin Max HP, Jingran menerima 6,2% Incoming Healing Bonus, hingga 310%.
- Jingran mendapat Fusion DMG Bonus berdasarkan Max HP: untuk setiap 1000 poin Max HP, Jingran menerima 1,5% Fusion DMG Bonus, hingga 75%.

Yang Changes, Yin Unites

Jingran mendapat tambahan ATK berdasarkan Max HP: untuk setiap 1000 poin Max HP, Jingran mendapat tambahan 36 ATK, hingga 1800.

description.en:
When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
While in Yin Vessel, press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.
While in Yang Font, press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.
description.id:
Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melakukan Tune Break pada target.
Saat dalam Yin Vessel, tekan atau tahan Normal Attack sesaat setelah menggunakan skill ini untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Drink Soul Tahap 2.
Saat dalam Yang Font, tekan atau tahan Normal Attack sesaat setelah menggunakan skill ini untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Tahap 2.

sequences.name: Yin and Yang in Harmony, the Ultimate Law of Being

description.en:
The DMG Multipliers of Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin, Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang, and Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide are increased by 80%.
Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin, Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang, and Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide are now immune to interruption.
description.id:
Pengali DMG Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin, Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang, dan Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide meningkat sebesar 80%.
Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin, Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang, dan Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide kini kebal terhadap interupsi.

sequences.name: A Solitary Lantern, Across Lands Shade-Trodden

description.en:
The DMG Multipliers of Heavy Attack - Soul Raid and Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander are increased by 46%. While in the Yinghuo state, the DMG Multiplier increase effect via Fire of Life on Heavy Attack - Soul Raid and Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander is increased by 46%.

Upon entering combat, Jingran gains the following effects, triggered once every 4s:
- Gains 300 point of Qi.
- Gains Netherworld's Boon.

Netherworld's Boon

Casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander restores 25% of Max Resonance Energy and grants Heavy Attack - Soul Raid and Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander 180% DMG Amplification for 4s.
description.id:
Pengali DMG Heavy Attack - Soul Raid dan Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander meningkat sebesar 46%. Saat dalam kondisi Yinghuo, efek peningkatan Pengali DMG melalui Fire of Life pada Heavy Attack - Soul Raid dan Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander meningkat sebesar 46%.

Saat memasuki pertempuran, Jingran mendapat efek berikut, terpicu sekali setiap 4 dtk:
- Mendapat 300 poin Qi.
- Mendapat Netherworld's Boon.

Netherworld's Boon

Menggunakan Heavy Attack - Soul Raid atau Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander memulihkan 25% Max Resonance Energy dan memberikan Heavy Attack - Soul Raid dan Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander 180% DMG Amplification selama 4 dtk.

sequences.name: World's Course Shifts, Each to Their Rightful Paths

description.en:
When Jingran casts Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander, gain 5 points of Ghost Shroud.

When Jingran casts Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls, Yang Changes, Yin Unites is replaced by Yin-Yang Everflow for 15s.

Yin-Yang Everflow

Jingran gains additional ATK based on Max HP: For every 1000 points of Jingran's Max HP, gain 50 additional ATK, up to 2500.
description.id:
Saat Jingran menggunakan Heavy Attack - Soul Raid atau Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander, mendapat 5 poin Ghost Shroud.

Saat Jingran menggunakan Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls, Yang Changes, Yin Unites digantikan oleh Yin-Yang Everflow selama 15 dtk.

Yin-Yang Everflow

Jingran mendapat tambahan ATK berdasarkan Max HP: untuk setiap 1000 poin Max HP Jingran, mendapat tambahan 50 ATK, hingga 2500.

sequences.name: Where Reality Meets Illusion, Where Living Meet Dead

description.en: When a Resonator in the team gains a Shield, all Resonators in the team gain 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for 30s.
description.id: Saat Resonator dalam tim mendapat Shield, semua Resonator dalam tim mendapat 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus selama 30 dtk.

sequences.name: Ends Return to Beginnings, Truth of Life Laid Bare

description.en: When Jingran takes a fatal blow, he will not fall and will instead gain a Shield equal to 50% of Max HP for 15s. This effect can be triggered once every 10 min. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.
description.id: Saat Jingran menerima serangan fatal, ia tidak akan tumbang dan sebagai gantinya mendapat Shield sebesar 50% Max HP selama 15 dtk. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali setiap 10 menit. Shield ini tidak akan diteruskan ke Resonator yang masuk.

sequences.name: As Favors and Feuds Fade, New Stories Await

description.en:
Targets take 40% more Heavy Attack DMG from Jingran.

The DMG Multiplier of Chimei Wangliang is increased by 80%.

Upon entering the Yinghuo state, Jingran gains the Parade of Thousand Souls effect for 15s. During this effect, if Jingran is the active Resonator in the team, upon dealing damage, Jingran summons Chimei Wangliang to attack the targets, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.

Chimei Wangliang can be summoned this way at an interval of 1s for up to 8 times. Parade of Thousand Souls ends and the available summon charges of Chimei Wangliang reset when either of the following conditions is met:
- Cast Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls.
- Yinghuo ends or is removed.
description.id:
Target menerima 40% lebih banyak Heavy Attack DMG dari Jingran.

Pengali DMG Chimei Wangliang meningkat sebesar 80%.

Saat memasuki kondisi Yinghuo, Jingran mendapat efek Parade of Thousand Souls selama 15 dtk. Selama efek ini, jika Jingran adalah Resonator aktif dalam tim, saat memberikan damage, Jingran memanggil Chimei Wangliang untuk menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.

Chimei Wangliang dapat dipanggil dengan cara ini dengan jeda 1 dtk hingga 8 kali. Parade of Thousand Souls berakhir dan charge pemanggilan Chimei Wangliang yang tersedia diatur ulang saat salah satu kondisi berikut terpenuhi:
- Menggunakan Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls.
- Yinghuo berakhir atau dihapus.
